articles.title: NASA’s Voyager 1 Makes History Reaching One Light-Day From Earth
articles.summary: NASA’s Voyager 1 probe, humanity’s farthest-flying spacecraft, has reached one light-day from Earth, after more than 49 years of constant travel. A light-day is the distance light travels in 24 hours, equaling about 16.1 billion miles (25.9 billion kilometers). The spacecraft achieved the milestone at 2:16 a.m. PST (5:16 a.m. EST) Nov. 18. articles.title: Vulcan failure investigation focuses on ‘inadequate fuel supply’ to booster engines
articles.summary: United Launch Alliance said Wednesday that a preliminary review of flight data points to an inadequate supply of fuel to the Blue Origin-manufactured engines of its Vulcan rocket, rather than a problem with the engines themselves, as the reason Sunday's launch fell short of orbit with 40 Amazon Leo internet satellites aboard.
